anchors.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset
anchors.reason: The bigP3BCI PhysioNet paper covers the whole multi-study P300 collection; nm000200 is only Study I (13 subjects), a derivative subset, so it is not this dataset's own data paper.

anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS; it is used for the dataset's formatting, not a paper describing the BigP3BCI data.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification used for formatting this dataset, not a paper describing the BigP3BCI Study I data.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) from 16 channels in a standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz, with a 60 Hz line frequency. Participants performed a visual P300 speller task in a laboratory setting with online feedback. Events were labeled Target or NonTarget, with a trial interval of 0-1.0 s.
